content:
Elon Musk outlined an expansion schedule for SpaceXAI's Colossus computing infrastructure, including a planned addition of 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs expected to be operational the following week.

In his description of the existing clusters, Colossus 1 included 150,000 H100 GPUs, 50,000 H200 GPUs and 30,000 GB200 units. Colossus 2 included 110,000 GB200 and 440,000 GB300 GPUs.

Musk also described plans for another 220,000 GB300 GPUs in November and a possible further 220,000 units by late December.

The remarks restate the same GPU expansion timetable discussed in the earlier SpaceXAI news report; no deployment milestone is newly confirmed.
headline: SpaceX supercluster adding 220k NVIDIA GB300 GPUs in compute scale-up
summary: Elon Musk confirmed SpaceX is adding 220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs to its Colossus cluster.
